LightningComponentBundle.description: Delays Flow output publication and navigation until screen inputs finish committing.

property.name: actionValue
property.label: Action Value
property.description: Value returned to the Flow when the button is clicked.

property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon Name
property.description: SLDS icon name, such as utility:record_update. Leave blank for no icon.

property.name: variant
property.label: Button Variant
property.description: Lightning button variant, such as brand or neutral.

property.name: alignment
property.label: Alignment
property.description: Button alignment: left, center, or right.

property.name: delayMs
property.label: Navigation Delay (Milliseconds)
property.description: Delay after focus transfer and before publishing the Flow output.

property.name: value
property.label: OUT - Action Value
property.description: The configured action value after the button is clicked.
